lines: In front of the gate of Gosha Academy, the head-to-head battle between Asagi-san and Sanada Homura was still on-going.
Homura
Here I go! Ninja Art: Fire Spear Strike!!
Asagi
Ugh!?
Sanada Homura unleashed a tremendous slash at Asagi with her flaming spearー
Asagi-san dodged the attack with blinding speed and boldly initiated her own attack.
*Cling!! Claaang*ー!!
Homura
Ahaha, look at you! You're the best, Igawa Asagi!!
Homura
It was well worth skipping hatsumode with my peeps for this!!
Me
So she was doing hatsumode too... Er, I mean, are you okay, Asagi-san!?
I called out to Asagi-san while going up against the Fire Art Squad blocking our path.
Asagi
Yes, I'm fine, but... this is not the time for this, for crying out loud...
Asagi-san sighed as if to say "Sheesh."
I would've liked to go and help her, but the Fire Art Squad wasn't going to let that happen.
Homura
We're not done yet, are we? Come on, entertain meeeee!
Homura readied her spear and faced Asagi with a battle-hungry grin.
Asagi
N-No, wait! Has nobody told you!?
Homura
Huh? Told me what?
Asagi
This boar here is a "scapegoat"! There's no point in killing it! Lower your spear!
Homura
Ahaha! I have no clue what you're talking about. Here I come, Igawa Asagi!!
Asagi
Tch, not much of a listener, huh... You leave me no choice. Come on then!!
ー*Clang!!!*
Their weapons crossed, and both of them jumped back as if repelled by their fierce blows.
The battle was seesawing back and forth.
It seemed like it would take some time for the result to be settled.
At that momentー
Fire Art Squad Member
Captain! A report from HQ!
A ninja who seemed to be one of Sanada Homura's subordinates came running over.
Homura
A report? Man... it was just getting good...
Fire Art Squad Member
Yes, ma'am. It appears the owner of Inageya provided some information.
Fire Art Squad Member

She said this boar we've been chasing is a "scapegoat"ー
that it's most likely only a decoy.
Homura
Whaaat!?
Homura stared at me (the boar) with eyes wide open while I was still confronting her Fire Art Squad.
Homura
Hey, you boar over there!! Are you a scapegoat!?
Me
Huh? Well, that's what it seems like.
When I replied, Homura muttered in disbelief.
Homura
Seriously...? You guys could've told me that a bit earlier.
Asagi
We did tell you!! I told you exactly that just a minute ago!!
Homura
Huh? You did? My bad, my bad! Our fight was so interesting I wasn't listening.
Homura cackled and relaxed her stance.
Homura
If that's how it is, we have no reason to duke it out anymore. But it was still pretty fun, so I'm satisfied!
Homura
...So, what's next? Are we supposed to work with these guys now?
Fire Art Squad Member
It looks like it. This boar here is apparently able to detect the real lucky boar's whereabouts.
Listening to what Homura said, the Fire Art Squad subordinate nodded.
Homura
Alright then! Hey, fake boar! Lead the way! We'll go with you to find the real boar!
Me
A-Alright...
Asagi
We're safe... but whether it be this girl or the last one, something doesn't sit right with me.
Asagi-san and I sighed, our mixed feelings showing on our faces just as they had earlier.
